readings: Group tracks by media type name. For each name, calculate its bytes-per-millisecond rate as the arithmetic mean of Bytes / Milliseconds across its tracks with non-null Bytes. Calculate the simple, unweighted average of those rates across all media type names with a defined rate. Keep names whose rate is above that overall average. In one unrounded row, return the arithmetic mean of the kept rates, the arithmetic mean of their track counts (counting all tracks with that media type name), and the arithmetic mean of their rates minus the overall average.

Group tracks by media type name. For each name, calculate its bytes-per-millisecond rate as the sum of Bytes divided by the sum of Milliseconds across its tracks with non-null Bytes. Calculate the simple, unweighted average of those rates across all media type names with a defined rate. Keep names whose rate is above that overall average. In one unrounded row, return the arithmetic mean of the kept rates, the arithmetic mean of their track counts (counting all tracks with that media type name), and the arithmetic mean of their rates minus the overall average.
queries:
WITH media_rates AS (
    SELECT
        m.Name,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds END) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS track_count
    FROM MediaType AS m
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.Name
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
    FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(r.rate),
    AVG(r.track_count),
    AVG(r.rate - o.average_rate)
FROM media_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate

WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT
    m.Name,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count,
    1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) /
      NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate
  FROM media_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(r.rate),
  AVG(r.track_count),
  AVG(r.rate - o.average_rate)
FROM media_rates AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE r.rate > o.average_rate
